name: Bank Account & Debit Card KYC Block Scam (English)

caller_script.text: Good morning sir, this is State Bank Head Office verification cell. Your savings account and debit card KYC validation has expired. Your account will be permanently blocked today by 5 PM.
You do not need to visit the branch. We are doing instant e-verification. You must transfer a refundable security deposit to our central RBI verification account.
Please write down the account number: five zero one zero zero four three two eight nine nine nine nine nine. IFSC code is HDFC0001234. Transfer immediately to avoid penalty.
